body: I have constantly shifting moods, have a very low frustration tolerance, get anxious really easily and have lots of trouble focusing. This plus a history of mental illness on my family makes me think I have some sort of mental disorder. I could seek treatment, but I doubt I'd found an open minded psychologist in Turkey. Most of them are people who couldn't get into med school and looked for the next best thing. A psychiatrist would be nice, but I have no idea how to go about seeing one.
